sources.name: OpenAL Soft
sources.upstream_version_notes: 1.25.2 plus one upstream commit, b96a19cf "Work around a Clang 19 issue with emplacing an optional" (chorus, distortion, fshifter, pshifter). Without it Clang 18/19 with libstdc++ 14 rejects std::optional<std::array<UpsampleParams, 4>>::emplace() and the Linux builds fail.

modification_notes: Windows llvm-mingw builds apply a CMake build-tree compatibility rewrite in alc/alc.cpp: use a lambda for EffectSlotCluster dereference so libc++ can resolve the std::views::transform adaptor. The pinned upstream source remains unchanged.
